edits.hypothesis: Adding an explicit completion rule instructing the model not to declare task_complete until final artifact files are generated and verified prevents premature task completion.
edits.why_not_lower_lever: Prose instructions in the system template are the precise lever for guiding high-level decision policies regarding when to declare completion.

retroactive_check.corrective: On bn-fit-modify, the agent completed early before running sampling; the prompt constraint instructs it to verify file existence first, forcing it to execute the sampling step.
retroactive_check.preservative: Does not disrupt successful iteration since successful agents naturally verify their outputs before concluding.
retroactive_check.transfer: Applies generally across tasks where agents finish core logic but forget final file generation/saving.

edits.regression_risk: None expected; only discourages premature stopping.
edits.mechanism: Adding an explicit completion rule instructing the model not to declare task_complete until final artifact files are generated and verified prevents premature task completion.

mechanism: Instruct the policy via template to verify output files exist before marking task_complete to prevent premature completion.
